content: For each position in the transmission, the request of PduR_- <User:LoTp>CopyTxData of the first destination lower layer module shall be for- warded with TpDataState set to TP_CONFPENDING .
For a new multicast TP transmission session, the request of PduR_<User:LoTp>CopyTxData of the first destination shall be forwarded with Tp DataState set to TP_CONFPENDING .
